description: Expander for Meter, sitting immediately to its right: a 24-pulse-per-quarter clock, a run gate, and triggers at one, two, four and up to a hundred and twenty-eight bars

outputs.text: A clock at twenty-four pulses per quarter note, taken from the Meter to its left
Carries 10V while the Meter to its left is running and 0V while it is stopped
A trigger every bar of the Meter to its left
A trigger every two bars of the Meter to its left
A trigger every four bars of the Meter to its left
A trigger every eight bars of the Meter to its left
A trigger every sixteen bars of the Meter to its left
A trigger every thirty-two bars of the Meter to its left
A trigger every sixty-four bars of the Meter to its left
A trigger every hundred and twenty-eight bars of the Meter to its left

notes: nothing comes out until a Meter is placed immediately to the left; with no Meter there the outputs stay at 0V
menu: Gate/trigger width — sets how long each trigger lasts: a fixed 1, 2, 5 or 10ms, or a share of that output's own period at 12.5, 25, 50, 75 or 87.5 per cent
